svg.title: Absentra
svg.desc: Attendance for small businesses from each employee's own phone: GPS and selfie clock-in, shifts, leave and a payroll recap under PP 35/2021. 30 MCP tools; GPS + selfie clock-in; PP 35/2021 overtime pay.
